cautions.text: Inconsistent bottom line with FY25 setback

profitability.footnote: Profitability spiked in 9M-FY26 but sustainability is questionable due to accounting adjustments in FY25.

valuation.takeaway: P/E of 15.51x based on 9M-FY26 earnings appears reasonable compared to peers, but relies on unsustainable bumper profits.

items.title: High Borrowings
items.detail: Overall borrowings of ₹242.57 Cr raise concerns about debt burden.

items.title: Contingent Liabilities
items.detail: Contingent liability of ₹61.64 Cr as of Dec 2025 is a significant alarm.

risks.bottomNote: The company has no listed peers, making valuation difficult, and financial inconsistencies raise red flags.

suggestion.detail: Well-informed investors may park moderate funds for long term, but caution is advised due to high debt and inconsistent profits.

positives: Strong R&D capabilities and 12 years of brand establishment
concerns: FY25 bottom line setback due to accounting adjustments

scripts.scene_0: POOJA LOGISTICS is hitting Dalal Street with a 214.48 crore IPO! Should you apply or avoid? Let's check the numbers.
scripts.scene_1: The issue size is 214.48 crore, with shares priced between 326 to 343. You can bid with a minimum investment of 274,400.
scripts.scene_2: Topline surged from 206.45 crore in FY24 to 236.50 crore in FY26, delivering a solid ~7% growth expansion.
scripts.scene_3: Here is the catch: POOJA LOGISTICS reported a net profit of 38.69Cr in FY26 Net Profit (PAT), continuing operational cash burn.
scripts.scene_4: At 343 per share, price to earnings is 15.51×, trading at 3.2 times sales against peers.
scripts.scene_5: Watch out for three big risks: High Borrowings, Contingent Liabilities. Never invest blindly without understanding the business.
scripts.scene_6: My personal take: growth is visible, but sustained profitability remains unproven. Listing gains look risky without positive operating cash flows.
scripts.scene_7: Turnarounds carry heavy execution risk. Don't decide based on grey market hype alone. Follow for data-driven IPO breakdowns every single week!
